bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
src=32a8f2ef5de41fceceb98ccc9532356962c877d5
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/tgtumbler-gserver-deploy-20261106 >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src" || { echo STK04_SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH; exit 72; }
d="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-stk04-live.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
git archive "$src" | tar -xf - -C "$d"
docker build --quiet -f "$d/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-stk04-pin:32a8f2ef "$d" >/dev/null || { echo STK04_DOCKER_BUILD_FAILED; exit 73; }
names="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$names" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_GAYBBS_CONTAINER_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 74; }
name="$names"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || { echo STK04_GAYBBS_NOT_RUNNING; exit 75; }
docker exec "$name" node --version >/dev/null || { echo STK04_GAYBBS_NODE_MISSING; exit 76; }
output="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-stk04-result.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"; rm -f "$output"' EXIT
if docker run --rm --entrypoint cat gace-stk04-pin:32a8f2ef /app/sticker-topic-pin.mjs | docker exec -i "$name" node --input-type=module - >"$output" 2>&1; then
 grep -E '^(STICKER_PIN_(OWNER|TARGET|TARGET_SOURCE|TELEGRAM_ACK|MESSAGE_ID|INDEPENDENT_READBACK)=)' "$output" || true
 grep -q '^STICKER_PIN_TELEGRAM_ACK=YES$' "$output" || { echo STK04_PIN_ACK_MISSING; exit 77; }
 echo STK04_LIVE_TOPIC_PIN_API_ACK=PASS
else
 grep -E '^(STICKER_PIN_(RESULT|ERROR)=)' "$output" || true
 echo STK04_LIVE_TOPIC_PIN_OPERATION_FAILED
 exit 78
fi
